        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 加载历史记录（用于模态框）\n  const loadHistoryRecords = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    setHistoryLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 获取项目的所有来源信息\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\n        params: {\n          pageType: &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;,\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 1000\n        }\n      });\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        // 过滤出历史记录（AI问答、技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿）\n        const historyCategories = ['ai-qa-summary', 'tech-package-qa', 'tech-strategy-qa', 'tech-article-qa', 'technical-translation'];\n        const filtered = response.data.data.filter((source: SourceInformation) =&gt; {\n          // 从 metadata 中解析 category\n          let category: string | undefined;\n          if (source.metadata) {\n            if (typeof source.metadata === 'string') {\n              try {\n                const parsed = JSON.parse(source.metadata);\n                category = parsed.category || parsed.sourceCategory;\n              } catch (e) {\n                // 忽略解析错误\n              }\n            } else if (typeof source.metadata === 'object') {\n              category = source.metadata.category || source.metadata.sourceCategory;\n            }\n          }\n          // 也检查直接设置的 category\n          if (source.category) {\n            category = source.category;\n          }\n          return category &amp;&amp; historyCategories.includes(category);\n        });\n        setHistoryRecords(filtered);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载历史记录失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setHistoryLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 获取来源的类别\n  const getSourceCategory = (source: SourceInformation)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class ChatMessageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 保存Dify聊天响应到数据库\n   */\n  static async saveDifyChatResponse(\n    response: DifyChatResponse,\n    userQuery: string,\n    appType: string,\n    inputs?: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; userMessage: ChatMessageRecord; assistantMessage: ChatMessageRecord }&gt; {\n    // 1. 创建或更新对话会话\n    const conversation = await this.upsertConversation({\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      app_type: appType,\n      session_name: userQuery.substring(0, 50) + (userQuery.length &gt; 50 ? '...' : ''),\n      status: 'active'\n    });\n\n    // 2. 保存用户消息\n    const userMessage = await this.saveChatMessage({\n      message_id: &#96;user_${response.id}_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      task_id: response.task_id,\n      message_type: 'user',\n      content: userQuery,\n      query: userQuery,\n      inputs: inputs ? JSON.stringify(inputs) : undefined,\n      app_type: appType,\n      status: 'completed'\n    });\n\n    // 3. 保存AI助手消息\n    const assistantMessage = await this.saveChatMessage({\n      message_id: response.id,\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      task_id: response.task_id,\n      message_type: 'assistant',\n      content: response.answer,\n      app_type: appType,\n      dify_event: response.event,\n      dify_mode: response.mode,\n      dify_answer: response.answer,\n      prompt_tokens: response.metadata?.usage?.prompt_tokens,\n      completion_tokens: response.metadata?.usage?.completion_tokens,\n      total_tokens: response.metadata?.usage?.total_tokens,\n      total_price: response.metadata?.usage?.total_price,\n      currency: response.metadata?.usage?.currency,\n      latency: response.metadata?.usage?.latency,\n      retriever_resources: response.metadata?.retriever_resources ? JSON.stringify(response.metadata.retriever_resources) : undefined,\n      status: 'completed'\n    });\n\n    return { conversation, userMessage, assistantMessage };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 保存Dify工作流响应到数据库\n   */\n  static async saveDifyWorkflowResponse(\n    response: DifyWorkflowResponse,\n    userQuery: string,\n    appType: string,\n    inputs?: any,\n    existingConversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; workflowExecution: WorkflowExecutionRecord }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

'...' : ''),\n        status: 'active'\n      });\n\n      // 保存用户消息\n      const userMessageId = &#96;user_${Date.now()}_${uuidv4()}&#96;;\n      await ChatMessageService.saveChatMessage({\n        message_id: userMessageId,\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\n        message_type: 'user',\n        content: userQuery,\n        query: userQuery,\n        app_type: 'direct-agent',\n        status: 'completed'\n      });\n\n      // 保存助手回复\n      const assistantMessageId = &#96;assistant_${Date.now()}_${uuidv4()}&#96;;\n      await ChatMessageService.saveChatMessage({\n        message_id: assistantMessageId,\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\n        message_type: 'assistant',\n        content: response.content,\n        app_type: 'direct-agent',\n        prompt_tokens: response.usage.promptTokens,\n        completion_tokens: response.usage.completionTokens,\n        total_tokens: response.usage.totalTokens,\n        status: 'completed'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('保存消息历史失败:', error);\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响主流程\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 生成对话ID\n   */\n  private generateConversationId(): string {\n    return &#96;conv-${Date.now()}-${uuidv4()}&#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst summarizeAndSaveConversation = async \n\n\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\n      try {\n        const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\n        const summaryPrompt = &#96;请对以下对话进行总结，生成一个简洁的标题（不超过30字）和一段摘要（不超过300字）。用中文回答，格式为：\n标题：[标题]\n摘要：[摘要内容]\n\n对话内容：\n${truncatedText}&#96;;\n\n        const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\n          summaryPrompt,\n          { context: [{ role: 'user', content: summaryPrompt }] },\n          (aiQAConfig &amp;&amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\n          undefined\n        );\n\n        if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data) {\n          const aiResponse = result.data.answer || result.data.result || '';\n          // 解析 AI 响应，提取标题和摘要\n          const titleMatch = aiResponse.match(/标题[：:]\\s*(.+)/);\n          const summaryMatch = aiResponse.match(/摘要[：:]\\s*(.+?)(?:\\n|$)/s);\n          \n          if (titleMatch &amp;&amp; titleMatch[1]) {\n            summaryTitle = titleMatch[1].trim();\n          }\n          if (summaryMatch &amp;&amp; summaryMatch[1]) {\n            summaryDescription = summaryMatch[1].trim();\n            // 如果 AI 生成的摘要太短，补充完整对话内容\n            if (summaryDescription.length &lt; 200) {\n              summaryDescription = &#96;${summaryDescription}\\n\\n完整对话内容：\\n${truncatedText}&#96;;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn('使用 AI 生成总结失败，使用简化版本:', error);\n        // 如果 AI 调用失败，使用简化版本\n        summaryTitle = aiMessages.length &gt; 0 \n          ? &#96;项目对话摘要（${aiMessages.length}条消息）&#96;\n          : '项目对话摘要';\n      }\n\n      // 创建来源信息\n      const sourceId = &#96;project_conversation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;\n      const source: Source = {\n        id: sourceId,\n        title: summaryTitle\n      };\n;\n;",

        "contents": "# 项目资源页面Agent调用分析\n\n## 分析结果\n\n### 1. AI问答功能 ✅ **调用Agent**\n\n**位置**: &#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&#96;\n**函数**: &#96;handleAISendMessage()&#96;\n\n**实现方式**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// 调用AI问答API\nconst result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\n  currentMessage,\n  inputs,\n  (aiQAConfig &amp;&amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\n  aiConversationId || undefined\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**调用链路**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nhandleAISendMessage()\n  ↓\nworkflowAPI.aiSearch()\n  ↓\nPOST /api/v1/workflow/ai-search\n  ↓\n后端工作流执行 / Dify调用\n  ↓\nAgent执行\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**特点**:\n- ✅ 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\n- ✅ 包含项目资源上下文（技术点、文件、知识点）\n- ✅ 通过工作流API调用，最终会调用Agent\n- ✅ 可以配置Dify配置（smart-workflow-ai-qa）\n\n**结论**: **是调用Agent的**\n\n---\n\n### 2. 技术转译功能 ❌ **不调用Agent**\n\n**位置**: &#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&#96;\n**函数**: &#96;handleTechnicalTranslation()&#96;\n\n**实现方式**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nconst handleTechnicalTranslation = async () =&gt; {\n  // 只是简单地拼接项目资源为markdown格式\n  const contentParts: string[] = [];\n  \n  // 1. 拼接已选择的技术点\n  // 2. 拼接已上传的文件\n  // 3. 拼接已选择的知识点\n  // 4. 拼接互联网信息点\n  \n  const finalContent = contentParts.join('');\n  setTranslatedContent(finalContent);\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**功能说明**:\n- 这是一个**纯前端的数据整理功能**\n- 将项目资源（技术点、文件、知识点、互联网信息）整理成markdown格式\n- **不涉及任何AI调用**\n- 只是将已选择的资源内容格式化输出\n\n**调用链路**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nhandleTechnicalTranslation()\n  ↓\n前端数据整理（拼接markdown）\n  ↓\n显示转译结果\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**结论**: **不是调用Agent的**，只是数据整理功能\n\n---\n\n## 总结\n\n| 功能 | 是否调用Agent | 说明 |\n|------|--------------|------|\n| **AI问答** | ✅ 是 | 通过&#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&#96;调用，最终会执行Agent |\n| **技术转译** | ❌ 否 | 纯前端数据整理，将项目资源格式化为markdown |",

        "contents": "const AiSearchNode: React.FC&lt;AiSearchNodeProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 处理确认保存\n  const handleConfirmSave = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      console.log(\"保存知识点:\", modalSelectedItems);\n      \n      // 记录采纳统计（如果提供了AI角色）\n      if (aiRole &amp;&amp; aiResponse) {\n        try {\n          const messageId = &#96;msg_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;\n          await workflowStatsService.recordAIQAFeedback({\n            message_id: messageId,\n            node_id: 'ai_search',\n            session_id: &#96;session_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n            feedback_type: 'adopt',\n            feedback_value: 5,\n            content_length: aiResponse.length,\n            ai_role_id: aiRole.id  // 关联AI角色ID\n          });\n          console.log('✅ 记录采纳统计成功');\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('记录采纳统计失败:', error);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 这里可以添加实际的保存逻辑\n      await new Promise((resolve) =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 1000)); // 模拟保存延迟\n      alert(&#96;已保存 ${modalSelectedItems.length} 个知识点&#96;);\n      setShowSaveModal(false);\n      setModalSelectedItems([]);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"保存失败:\", error);\n      alert(\"保存失败，请重试\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleExport = () =&gt; {\n    if (userContent) {\n      // 创建一个Blob对象包含用户内容，使用markdown格式\n      const blob = new Blob([userContent], {\n        type: \"text/markdown;charset=utf-8\",\n      });\n\n      // 创建下载链接\n      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n      const link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n      link.href = url;\n      link.download = &#96;ai-search-result-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.md&#96;;\n\n      // 触发下载\n      document.body.appendChild(link);\n      link.click();\n      document.body.removeChild(link);\n\n      // 清理URL对象\n      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 快捷功能按钮处理函数\n  const handleCopy = async () =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const AIChat: React.FC&lt;AIChatProps&gt; = ({ onMessageSend }) =&gt; {\n  const [messages, setMessages] = useState&lt;Message[]&gt;([]);\n  const [inputMessage, setInputMessage] = useState(\"\");\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const messagesEndRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);\n  const inputRef = useRef&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;(null);\n\n  const scrollToBottom = () =&gt; {\n    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: \"smooth\" });\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    scrollToBottom();\n  }, [messages]);\n\n  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) =&gt; {\n    if (e.key === \"Enter\" &amp;&amp; !isLoading) {\n      handleSendMessage();\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSendMessage = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!inputMessage.trim() || isLoading) return;\n\n    const userMessage: Message = {\n      id: Date.now().toString(),\n      content: inputMessage.trim(),\n      sender: \"user\",\n      timestamp: new Date(),\n    };\n\n    setMessages((prev) =&gt; [...prev, userMessage]);\n    setInputMessage(\"\");\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    onMessageSend?.(inputMessage.trim());\n\n    // 模拟AI回复\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n      const aiMessage: Message = {\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\n        content: &#96;我理解您的问题：\"${inputMessage.trim()}\"。让我为您提供一些建议和帮助。这是一个很好的问题，我会根据您的需求提供相应的解决方案。&#96;,\n        sender: \"ai\",\n        timestamp: new Date(),\n      };\n      setMessages((prev) =&gt; [...prev, aiMessage]);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }, 1500);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"ai-search-component\" data-oid=\"iy9xey3\"&gt;\n;",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n        \n        logger.info('准备发送消息到Dify工作流', {\n          本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n          DifyConversationId: difyConversationId || '未设置（首次对话，Dify将返回新的conversation_id）',\n        });\n        \n        // 将 Dify conversation_id 添加到 workflowInput 中，这样 Agent 节点可以获取到\n        if (difyConversationId) {\n          workflowInput.conversationId = difyConversationId;\n          logger.info('已设置Dify conversation_id到工作流输入', { difyConversationId });\n        } else {\n          logger.info('首次对话，未设置Dify conversation_id，Dify将创建新的对话');\n        }\n\n        const workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(finalWorkflowId, {\n          input: workflowInput,\n        });\n\n        // 从工作流执行结果中提取 Dify conversation_id\n        // Agent 节点的输出中可能包含 conversation_id\n        let newDifyConversationId: string | null = null;\n        \n        // 尝试从工作流执行结果的数据中提取 conversation_id\n        // 首先检查 outputs 中是否包含 conversation_id\n        if (workflowResult?.data?.outputs) {\n          const outputs = workflowResult.data.outputs;\n          if (outputs.conversation_id &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.conversation_id === 'string') {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.conversation_id;\n          } else if (outputs.output &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.output === 'object' &amp;&amp; outputs.output.conversation_id) {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.output.conversation_id;\n          } else if (outputs.metadata &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.metadata === 'object' &amp;&amp; outputs.metadata.conversation_id) {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.metadata.conversation_id;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果还没有找到，尝试从 extractedOutput 中提取\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ChatMessageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 保存Dify聊天响应到数据库\n   */\n  static async saveDifyChatResponse(\n    response: DifyChatResponse,\n    userQuery: string,\n    appType: string,\n    inputs?: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; userMessage: ChatMessageRecord; assistantMessage: ChatMessageRecord }&gt; {\n    // 1. 创建或更新对话会话\n    const conversation = await this.upsertConversation({\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      app_type: appType,\n      session_name: userQuery.substring(0, 50) + (userQuery.length &gt; 50 ? '...' : ''),\n      status: 'active'\n    });\n\n    // 2. 保存用户消息\n    const userMessage = await this.saveChatMessage({\n      message_id: &#96;user_${response.id}_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      task_id: response.task_id,\n      message_type: 'user',\n      content: userQuery,\n      query: userQuery,\n      inputs: inputs ? JSON.stringify(response.metadata.retriever_resources) : undefined,\n      status: 'completed'\n    });\n\n    return { conversation, userMessage, assistantMessage };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 保存Dify工作流响应到数据库\n   */\n  static async saveDifyWorkflowResponse(\n    response: DifyWorkflowResponse,\n    userQuery: string,\n    appType: string,\n    inputs?: any,\n    existingConversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; workflowExecution: WorkflowExecutionRecord }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { ChatMessageService } from '@/services/ChatMessageService';\nimport DifyClient from '@/services/DifyClient';\nimport { db } from '@/config/database';\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\n\nimport { ExecuteAiSearchDTO } from '../dto/executeAiSearch.dto';\n\nexport class ExecuteAiSearchUseCase {\n  async execute(dto: ExecuteAiSearchDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;unknown&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      logger.info('执行 AI 搜索', { query: dto.query });\n\n      const processedInputs = await this.processInputs(dto.inputs);\n      const result = await DifyClient.aiSearch(dto.query, processedInputs, dto.conversationId ?? '');\n\n      await ChatMessageService.saveDifyChatResponse(result, dto.query, 'ai-search', processedInputs);\n\n      return success(result);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('AI 搜索执行失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'AI_SEARCH_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'AI搜索失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async processInputs(inputs: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt; = {}) {\n    const processedInputs = { ...inputs } as Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 发送消息\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\n */\nrouter.post(\n  '/conversations/:id/messages',\n  ensureTablesInitialized,\n  upload.array('files', 10),\n  async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const { id } = req.params;\n      let sourcesValue = req.body.sources;\n      if (typeof sourcesValue === 'string') {\n        try {\n          sourcesValue = JSON.parse(sourcesValue);\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          logger.warn('解析sources失败，使用原始值', { parseError });\n          sourcesValue = undefined;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const body = {\n        content: req.body.content,\n        sources: Array.isArray(sourcesValue) ? sourcesValue : undefined,\n        contextWindowSize: req.body.contextWindowSize,\n        workflowId: req.body.workflowId,\n        fileList: req.body.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: req.body.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      };\n      const files = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n\n      const dto = validateDTO(SendMessageSchema, body);\n      const result = await sendMessageUseCase.execute({\n        conversationId: id,\n        content: dto.content,\n        sources: dto.sources,\n        files,\n        contextWindowSize: typeof dto.contextWindowSize === 'number' ? dto.contextWindowSize : (dto.contextWindowSize ? parseInt(String(dto.contextWindowSize), 10) : undefined),\n        workflowId: dto.workflowId,\n        fileList: dto.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: dto.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      });\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          formatApiResponse(false, null, '发送消息失败', result.error.message)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(\n        formatApiResponse(\n          true,\n          result.value,\n          result.value.error ? '发送消息成功，但工作流执行失败' : '发送消息成功'\n        )\n      );\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof ValidationException) {\n        const failure = formatValidationFailure(error);\n  }",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const userMessageRecord = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n        params.conversationId,\n        'user',\n        params.content,\n        params.sources || [],\n        params.files || []\n      );\n\n      const conversationRecord = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(params.conversationId);\n\n      try {\n        const requestedWorkflowId = params.workflowId;\n        const finalWorkflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n\n        if (!finalWorkflowId) {\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const mappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, finalWorkflowId);\n\n        if (!mappingConfig) {\n          const message =\n            requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === finalWorkflowId\n              ? &#96;所选工作流(${finalWorkflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n              : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: message,\n            errorDetail: '请在字段映射配置中为该工作流完成输入输出映射',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const conversationData = await this.buildConversationData({\n          conversation: conversationRecord,\n          content: params.content,\n          sources: params.sources,\n          files: params.files,\n          contextWindowSize: params.contextWindowSize,\n          workflowId: finalWorkflowId,\n          fileList: params.fileList,\n          knowledgeBaseNames: params.knowledgeBaseNames,\n        });\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const AiSearchNode: React.FC&lt;AiSearchNodeProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 处理确认保存\n  const handleConfirmSave = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSaving(true);\n    try {\n      console.log(\"保存知识点:\", modalSelectedItems);\n      \n      // 记录采纳统计（如果提供了AI角色）\n      if (aiRole &amp;&amp; aiResponse) {\n        try {\n          const messageId = &#96;msg_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;\n          await workflowStatsService.recordAIQAFeedback({\n            message_id: messageId,\n            node_id: 'ai_search',\n            session_id: &#96;session_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n            feedback_type: 'adopt',\n            feedback_value: 5,\n            content_length: aiResponse.length,\n            ai_role_id: aiRole.id  // 关联AI角色ID\n          });\n          console.log('✅ 记录采纳统计成功');\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('记录采纳统计失败:', error);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 这里可以添加实际的保存逻辑\n      await new Promise((resolve) =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 1000)); // 模拟保存延迟\n      alert(&#96;已保存 ${modalSelectedItems.length} 个知识点&#96;);\n      setShowSaveModal(false);\n      setModalSelectedItems([]);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"保存失败:\", error);\n      alert(\"保存失败，请重试\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleExport = () =&gt; {\n    if (userContent) {\n      // 创建一个Blob对象包含用户内容，使用markdown格式\n      const blob = new Blob([userContent], {\n        type: \"text/markdown;charset=utf-8\",\n      });\n\n      // 创建下载链接\n      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n      const link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n      link.href = url;\n      link.download = &#96;ai-search-result-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.md&#96;;\n\n      // 触发下载\n      document.body.appendChild(link);\n      link.click();\n      document.body.removeChild(link);\n\n      // 清理URL对象\n      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 快捷功能按钮处理函数\n  const handleCopy = async () =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const PressReleaseNode: React.FC&lt;PressReleaseNodeProps&gt; = \nconst [conversationId, setConversationId] = &lt;string | undefined&gt;(undefined);\n\n  // 处理AI搜索\n  const handleAiSearch = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!query.trim()) return;\n\n    setInternalLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 添加用户消息到历史\n      const userMessage: ChatMessage = {\n        id: Date.now().toString(),\n        type: \"user\",\n        content: query,\n        timestamp: Date.now(),\n      };\n      setChatHistory((prev) =&gt; {\n    setLiked(!liked);\n    if (disliked) setDisliked(false);\n  };\n\n  // 处理点踩\n  const handleDislike = () =&gt; {\n    setDisliked(!disliked);\n    if (liked) setLiked(false);\n  };\n\n  // 处理复制\n  const handleCopy = () =&gt; {\n    navigator.clipboard.writeText(aiResponse);\n  };\n\n  // 处理分享\n  const handleShare = () =&gt; {\n    // 分享逻辑\n    console.log(\"分享发布会稿内容\");\n  };\n\n  // 处理重新生成\n  const handleRegenerate = () =&gt; {\n    handleAiSearch();\n  };\n\n  // 处理知识点选择变化\n  const handleSelectionChange = (items: SelectionItem[])\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n        \n        // 如果还没有找到，尝试从 extractedOutput 中提取\n        const extractedOutput = extractWorkflowOutput(workflowResult, mappingConfig.outputMappings);\n        if (!newDifyConversationId &amp;&amp; extractedOutput &amp;&amp; typeof extractedOutput === 'object') {\n          const outputObj = extractedOutput as any;\n          if (outputObj.conversation_id &amp;&amp; typeof outputObj.conversation_id === 'string') {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputObj.conversation_id;\n          }\n        }\n\n        // 如果获取到了新的 conversation_id，保存到对话记录中\n        if (newDifyConversationId) {\n          await this.aiSearchService.updateDifyConversationId(params.conversationId, newDifyConversationId);\n          logger.info('✅ 已更新对话的 Dify conversation_id', {\n            本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n            DifyConversationId: newDifyConversationId,\n            是否首次对话: !difyConversationId,\n          });\n        } else {\n          logger.warn('⚠️ 未从Dify工作流响应中提取到conversation_id', {\n            本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n            之前是否有DifyConversationId: !!difyConversationId,\n          });\n        }\n\n        // 辅助函数：确保内容是字符串\n        const ensureStringContent = (content: any)\n;\n  }\n}",

({ source_id: s.source_id, title: s.title }))\n      });\n\n      const response = await api.post(\"/source-information/batch\", sourceInfoList);\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存响应:', {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        dataCount: response.data.data?.length || 0,\n        error: response.data.error\n      });\n      \n      return {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        data: response.data.data,\n        error: response.data.error,\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息失败:\", error);\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 错误详情:\", {\n        message: error.message,\n        response: error.response?.data,\n        status: error.response?.status\n      });\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error.response?.data?.error || error.message || \"批量保存来源信息失败\",\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID加载来源信息\n   */\n  async loadSourceInformationByConversationId(\n    conversationId: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: Source[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt;   "contents": "        timestamp: new Date(),\n      };\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&gt; [...prev, errorMessage]);\n    } finally {\n      setAiLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 自动保存对话摘要\n  const autoSaveConversationSummary = async () =&gt; {\n    // 检查是否有至少一轮完整的问答（至少一条用户消息和一条AI消息）\n    const userMessages = aiMessages.filter(msg =&gt; msg.sender === 'user');\n    const aiResponseMessages = aiMessages.filter(msg =&gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\n    \n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\n    try {\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录\n        try {\n          await api.delete(&#96;/source-information/${savedConversationSourceId}&#96;);\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 保存新的对话摘要\n      const sourceId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation('tech-package'); // 使用tech-package作为默认pageType，因为这是项目资源页面\n      \n      if (sourceId) {\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(sourceId);\n        \n        // 刷新历史记录\n        await loadSources(); // 重新加载来源列表\n        await checkHistoryRecords(); // 检查并更新历史记录视图\n        \n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 对话摘要已自动保存:', sourceId);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 自动保存对话摘要失败:', error);\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\n    }\n  };",

代码已修改。总结修改内容：

## 修改总结

1. 添加状态跟踪：新增 `savedConversationSourceId` 用于跟踪已保存的对话记录 ID。

2. 自动保存对话摘要：AI 回复完成后自动保存对话摘要：
   - 检查是否有至少一轮完整问答（至少一条用户消息和一条 AI 消息）
   - 保存前先删除旧的对话记录（如果存在）
   - 使用 `project-${projectId}` 作为 pageType
   - 保存后刷新历史记录并更新视图

3. 改进保存逻辑：
   - 修改 `summarizeAndSaveConversation`，支持可选的 `messages` 参数
   - 确保使用最新的消息列表进行保存

4. 历史记录自动刷新：保存后自动调用 `loadSources()` 和 `checkHistoryRecords()`，更新历史记录视图。

现在，在 AI 问答助手完成对话后，会自动保存对话摘要到历史记录，并在历史记录视图中显示。

请测试该功能，确认对话完成后历史记录是否正确显示。

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\nprivate async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n\n      \n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = techPointData;\n        await techPointModel.update(existing.id, updateData);\n        created = false;\n      } else {\n        // 创建新技术点\n        await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n        created = true;\n      }\n\n      // 同步关联的车型（如果有）\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\n        // 这里可以添加同步车型关联的逻辑\n        // 由于车型关联可能涉及复杂的业务逻辑，暂时跳过\n        logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${techPointDetail.carModels.length} 个车型&#96;);\n      }\n\n      return { created };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error(&#96;同步技术点 ${tpdTechPoint.id} 失败:&#96;, error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射技术点类型\n   */\n  private mapTechType(tpdType: string): TechType {\n    const typeMap: Record&lt;string, TechType&gt; = {\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE\n,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 更新技术点\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n    const fields: string[] = [];\n    const values: any[] = [];\n\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n      if (value !== undefined) {\n        if (['tags', 'technical_details', 'benefits', 'applications', 'keywords'].includes(key)) {\n          fields.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(JSON.stringify(value));\n        } else {\n          fields.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(value);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\n      return this.findById(id);\n    }\n\n    values.push(id);\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE tech_points \n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      WHERE id = ?\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result.length &gt; 0 ? this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint : null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除技术点（软删除）\n   */\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    // 检查是否有子技术点\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\n  }\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./frontend/src/hooks/useTechPoints.ts",
        "range": {

        "contents": "import {\n  TechPoint,\n  TechCategory,\n  CarModel,\n  TechPointStats,\n  TechPointSearchParams,\n  TechPointFormData,\n  PaginatedResponse\n} from '../types/techPoint';\nimport { techPointService } from '../services/techPointService';\n\nexport const useTechPoints = () =&gt; {\n  const [techPoints, setTechPoints] = useState&lt;TechPoint[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState({\n    total: 0,\n    page: 1,\n    pageSize: 20,\n    totalPages: 0\n  });\n\n  // 获取技术点列表\n  const fetchTechPoints = useCallback(async (params?: TechPointSearchParams) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints(params);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setTechPoints(response.data.data);\n        setPagination({\n          total: response.data.total,\n          page: response.data.page,\n          pageSize: response.data.pageSize,\n          totalPages: response.data.totalPages\n        });\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '获取技术点列表失败');\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('获取技术点列表失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  // 创建技术点\n  const createTechPoint = useCallback(async (data: TechPointFormData) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.createTechPoint(data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        // 重新获取列表\n        await fetchTechPoints();\n        return true;\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '创建技术点失败');\n        return false;\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('创建技术点失败');\n      return false;\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [fetchTechPoints]);\n\n  // 更新技术点\n  const updateTechPoint = useCallback\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\nprivate async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n\n      \n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = techPointData;\n        await techPointModel.update(existing.id, updateData);\n        created = false;\n      } else {\n        // 创建新技术点\n        await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n        created = true;\n      }\n\n      // 同步关联的车型（如果有）\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\n        // 这里可以添加同步车型关联的逻辑\n        // 由于车型关联可能涉及复杂的业务逻辑，暂时跳过\n        logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${techPointDetail.carModels.length} 个车型&#96;);\n      }\n\n      return { created };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error(&#96;同步技术点 ${tpdTechPoint.id} 失败:&#96;, error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射技术点类型\n   */\n  private mapTechType(tpdType: string): TechType {\n    const typeMap: Record&lt;string, TechType&gt; = {\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE\n,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class KnowledgePointService {\n\n\n  // 创建知识点\n  async createKnowledgePoint(data: CreateKnowledgePointDTO): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO knowledge_points (\n        tech_point_id, title, content, knowledge_type, difficulty_level,\n        tags, prerequisites, learning_objectives, examples, references,\n        status, created_by\n      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const params = [\n      data.tech_point_id,\n      data.title,\n      data.content,\n      data.knowledge_type,\n      data.difficulty_level,\n      JSON.stringify(data.tags || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.prerequisites || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.learning_objectives || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.examples || []),\n      JSON.stringify(data.references || []),\n      data.status || 'active',\n      data.created_by\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n    const knowledgePointId = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n    \n    const knowledgePoint = await this.getKnowledgePointById(knowledgePointId);\n    if (!knowledgePoint) {\n      throw new Error('Failed to create knowledge point');\n    }\n    \n    return knowledgePoint;\n  }\n\n  // 根据ID获取知识点\n  async getKnowledgePointById(id: number): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint | null&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM knowledge_points WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export const useTechPoints = \n\n\n  // 更新技术点\n  const updateTechPoint = useCallback(async (id: number, data: Partial&lt;TechPointFormData&gt;) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.updateTechPoint(id, data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        // 重新获取列表\n        await fetchTechPoints();\n        return true;\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '更新技术点失败');\n        return false;\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('更新技术点失败');\n      return false;\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [fetchTechPoints]);\n\n  // 删除技术点\n  const deleteTechPoint = useCallback(async (id: number) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.deleteTechPoint(id);\n      if (response.success) {\n        // 重新获取列表\n        await fetchTechPoints();\n        return true;\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '删除技术点失败');\n        return false;\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('删除技术点失败');\n      return false;\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [fetchTechPoints]);\n\n  // 搜索技术点\n  const searchTechPoints = useCallback(async (keyword: string, params?: Omit&lt;TechPointSearchParams, 'keyword'&gt;) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.searchTechPoints(keyword, params);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setTechPoints(response.data.data);\n        setPagination({\n          total: response.data.total,\n          page: response.data.page,\n          pageSize: response.data.pageSize,\n          totalPages: response.data.totalPages\n        });\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '搜索技术点失败');\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('搜索技术点失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  return {\n    techPoints,\n    loading,\n    error,\n    pagination,\n;",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 更新技术点\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n    const fields: string[] = [];\n    const values: any[] = [];\n\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n      if (value !== undefined) {\n        if (['tags', 'technical_details', 'benefits', 'applications', 'keywords'].includes(key)) {\n          fields.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(JSON.stringify(value));\n        } else {\n          fields.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(value);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\n      return this.findById(id);\n    }\n\n    values.push(id);\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE tech_points \n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      WHERE id = ?\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result.length &gt; 0 ? this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint : null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除技术点（软删除）\n   */\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    // 检查是否有子技术点\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\n  }\n}",

            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n      }\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {
          "ranges": [
            {
              "startPosition": {
                "line": 10,
